title: festuca rubra subsp. eriantha
intro: Festuca rubra subsp. eriantha, commonly known as red fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This perennial grass has been used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca rubra subsp. eriantha include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety, and act as an antiseptic, making it a valuable remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a promising candidate for further research into its potential health benefits.
